trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: Novels give rise debates and give voice of silence.
trap.right: Novels give rise to debates and give voice to silence.
trap.why: Português “dar origem a/dar voz a” é igual, mas o brasileiro esquece o to final nas expressões fixas.

fix.wrong: The poem gives a voice of the poor.
fix.right: The poem gives voice to the poor.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com give rise to: “Novels cause debates.”
Reescreva com give voice to: “The poem expresses the silence.”
rewrite.answer: The poem gives voice to the silence.
